_about: VK-50 WARDEN moving parts. Origins are pivots; rotations are about the object's local axis.
axes: Blender Z-up, muzzle -Y.  glTF/Bevy Y-up, muzzle +Z: (x, y, z)_blender -> (x, z, -y)_gltf

WARDEN_Bolt.sequence: open: lift, then slide back; close: slide forward, then lower

WARDEN_StockFolding_Arm.note: rotate about local Z by fold_angle_deg: stock swings out to +X and lies along the LEFT side

WARDEN_Mag5.round_index_rule: round_index 1 = top round at the feed lips; hide the highest indices first
WARDEN_Mag5.follower_rule: raise the follower along local +Z by follower_offset_by_rounds_left_m[rounds_left] (index 0 = empty: right under the feed lips). The step under the centred top round is larger than travel_per_round_m, so use the table rather than n * travel_per_round_m
